unit.why: A homiletic warning against followers of rival rebbes maligning one another, built around a short transmitted narrative: on a journey, the Besht weeps in the forest at mincha because he foresees that pre-messianic rebbes will delay the redemption.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי ממורי וחמי שהי׳ תלמיד מובהק
stories.end_quote: כי כך נצטויתי בחלום הלילה עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: During a journey the Besht goes into the forest to pray mincha, strikes his head against a tree and weeps; when his disciples ask why, he explains that he foresaw that near the messianic era there will be swarms of rebbes whose divisiveness will delay the redemption, and the author draws a warning about choosing a tsaddik and guarding one's tongue.

tags.why: The short narrative sits inside an extended ethical-homiletic frame against slander and on choosing a rebbe.
The episode happens while the Besht is travelling.
The Besht prays mincha in the forest.
He withdraws to the forest to pray.
He sees the future through holy spirit.

quotes: שיהיו רביים כארבה לרוב והם הם יעכבו את הגאולה
tags.why: He predicts the proliferation of rebbes; the frame implies it has come true in the author's 'evil generation'.
Messianic redemption and its delay are central.
The pre-messianic generations and the delay of redemption are the theme.

quotes: וצועק ובוכה צעקות משוכות ובכיה רבה
tags.why: The Besht weeps and cries out in grief.

quotes: וראו התלמידים שמכה ראשו מאד באילן
tags.why: The disciples witness the scene and question their master.

quotes: מדבר סרה ופוער פיו לבלי חק על רבי שבעיר אחרת
tags.why: Rivalry and slander between the camps of different rebbes is the problem addressed.

quotes: לדבק עצמו בצדיק הדור כי זה כל אדם
tags.why: Discusses cleaving to the true tsaddik and discerning a false rebbe.
Journeying to a rebbe is discussed in general terms, not depicted as an event.

quotes: ותשמור פיך מלדבר סרה אם לא על מפורסם ברשעו
tags.why: The text gives a prohibition against slandering tsaddikim.
The author says a dream commanded him to write this; it is part of the frame only.
